name: ES Overnight Profile & RTH Reaction
description: Computes volume and market profile levels (POC, VAH, VAL) for the ES Globex overnight session (18:00–09:30 ET), then analyzes how RTH reacts to those levels. Tracks whether RTH opens above/below/inside the overnight value area and whether price tests the overnight POC during RTH. Uses 500-bar rolling price_profile window to capture the bulk of the overnight session.
source:
# ES Overnight Session Profile & RTH Reaction
# Computes volume profile (POC, VAH, VAL) during Globex overnight (18:00-09:30 ET)
# Then tracks how RTH reacts: open position relative to value area + POC tests

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c
high = cont.h
low = cont.l
open_price = cont.o
volume = cont.v

# --- Session Definitions ---
# Overnight Globex session: 18:00 ET to 09:30 ET
overnight = session_window(
    session=Session(start='18:00', end='09:30', tz='America/New_York')
)(cont.o, cont.h, cont.l, cont.c, cont.v)

# RTH session: 09:30 ET to 16:00 ET
rth = session_window(
    session=SessionType.EquityRTHSession
)(cont.o, cont.h, cont.l, cont.c, cont.v)

# --- Volume Profile on Overnight Session Bars (tick_size=1.0 for ES) ---
# Feed overnight session OHLCV so profile is computed on overnight-only bars
vp = price_profile(
    window_size=500,
    tick_size=1.0,
    value_area_pct=0.7,
    mode=ProfileType.volume
)(overnight.high, overnight.low, overnight.close, overnight.volume)

# --- Market Profile (TPO-based) on Overnight Session Bars ---
mp = price_profile(
    window_size=500,
    tick_size=1.0,
    value_area_pct=0.7,
    mode=ProfileType.market
)(overnight.high, overnight.low, overnight.close, overnight.volume)

# --- Capture Overnight Levels at Session Close ---
# Triple gate: opened AND closed to avoid phantom events (S19)
on_close_valid = overnight.closed and overnight.opened

# Volume profile levels at overnight close
on_vpoc = where(on_close_valid, vp.poc)
on_vah = where(on_close_valid, vp.vah)
on_val = where(on_close_valid, vp.val)
on_va_width = where(on_close_valid, vp.va_width)

# Market profile levels at overnight close
on_mpoc = where(on_close_valid, mp.poc)

# Overnight session range
on_high = where(on_close_valid, overnight.high)
on_low = where(on_close_valid, overnight.low)
on_close_price = where(on_close_valid, overnight.close)
on_volume_total = where(on_close_valid, overnight.volume)

# Persist overnight levels into RTH via ffill_day
vpoc_level = ffill_day(on_vpoc)
vah_level = ffill_day(on_vah)
val_level = ffill_day(on_val)
mpoc_level = ffill_day(on_mpoc)
on_high_level = ffill_day(on_high)
on_low_level = ffill_day(on_low)

# --- RTH Reaction Analysis ---
# RTH open price (persisted through session)
rth_open = ffill_day(where(rth.opened, close))

# Where did RTH open relative to overnight value area?
# 1 = above VAH (bullish), -1 = below VAL (bearish), 0 = inside VA (balanced)
rth_open_position = where(rth.opened,
    conditional_select(
        is_valid(rth_open) and is_valid(vah_level) and rth_open > vah_level, 1.0,
        is_valid(rth_open) and is_valid(val_level) and rth_open < val_level, -1.0,
        0.0
    )
)

# Did RTH test overnight VPOC? (price within 1 point of VPOC during RTH)
vpoc_test = rth.active and is_valid(vpoc_level) and abs(close - vpoc_level) <= 1.0
is_vpoc_touch = vpoc_test and not (vpoc_test >> 1)

# Overnight range as percentage (compute at session close)
on_range_pct = where(on_close_valid,
    (on_high - on_low) / on_low * 100
)

# --- Reporters ---
ts = index().value

# 1. CONTEXT: Overnight profile levels over time (line chart)
xy_lines(
    title='Overnight Profile Levels vs Price',
    y_axis_label='Price',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    category='Overnight Profile',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='VPOC', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='VAH', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='VAL', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(close, vpoc_level, vah_level, val_level))

# 2. PUNCHLINE: RTH open position relative to overnight value area
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.Count,
    title='Where Does RTH Open vs Overnight Value Area?',
    x_axis_label='Position',
    y_axis_label='Session Count',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.IntegerFormat,
    category='Overnight Profile',
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=False,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Sessions', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[]),
    order=2
)(values=rth_open_position, label=conditional_select(
    is_valid(rth_open_position) and rth_open_position > 0.5, 'Above VAH',
    is_valid(rth_open_position) and rth_open_position < -0.5, 'Below VAL',
    'Inside VA'
))

# 3. DISTRIBUTION: Overnight range width distribution
histogram(
    title='How Wide Is the Overnight Range?',
    bins=25,
    x_axis_label='Overnight Range (%)',
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    category='Overnight Profile',
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    show_analytics=True,
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    order=3
)(on_range_pct)

# 4. EVENT MAP: VPOC touch events during RTH
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='RTH Tests Overnight VPOC',
        icon=Icon.TargetIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='VPOC Level', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Price at Touch', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='ON High', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='ON Low', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(vpoc_level, close, on_high_level, on_low_level, is_vpoc_touch)
